title: Shared Password Notebook
scenario: A relative suggests keeping all family passwords in a shared note.

answers.A: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.B: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.C: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.
answers.D: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.

explanation: Shared Password Notebook: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Use a password manager, not shared unsecured notes.
